name: tvinto-sync
description: Tvinto's sync service: your accounts, devices and what they share, on your own Cloudflare account.

DB.description: Accounts and what their devices share. Subscriptions and guides arrive sealed on the devices and cannot be read here.

ACCOUNT_SALT_SECRET.description: Any long random string, kept secret. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION.description: `first-only`: the first account is free to make and every other one needs an invite code from an account here. `closed`: invite codes only. `open`: anybody who finds the address.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Where the apps call from. Leave as it is.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
